title: Nonexistence of multi-bubble radial solutions to the 3D energy critical wave equation
summary: In this work we consider the focusing, energy-critical wave equation in 3D radial case. It has been verified that any global or type II blow-up solution decomposes into a superposition of several decoupled grounds states, a free wave and a small error, as time tends to infinity or the blow-up time. This is usually called soliton resolution. However, all known examples of soliton resolution in the 3D radial case come with no more than one soliton.
